subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Rules work better when people understand what they protect.”?
options: People need to know what a chart means before fear fills the empty spaces.
A plant is easier to respect when you know it may become your soup.
She only wanted to give some small things a chance to become important later.
It is deciding how to respect both the artist's intention and the object's history.
